items:
Welcome to "4C's Retreat", a luxury home in the prestigious beach community of The Preserve at Grayton Beach. Any richly appointed home begins with great outdoor spaces and this home is no exception.

You have multiple venues where everyone can relax and take in all nature has to offer. Outdoor dining, spaces for relaxation, and a gas grill to complete your outdoor experience. 4C's Retreat is also located as you first enter The Preserve, so beach access only steps away. A private boardwalk is close by for each beach access, one of only three on 30A! Making it easy to transport your beach wagons, strollers, and coolers to the shimmering sands of the Gulf!!

Upon entry, you're welcomed into the spacious open Great Room with multiple seating areas and luxury upgrades like trey ceilings, hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and high-end furnishings. The formal dining area offers seating for six and the breakfast bar, and an additional four so that everyone can enjoy meals together. The Gourmet kitchen spares no expense with marble countertops, high-end stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and a center island. Making it easy to make your early morning cup of coffee and culinary creations in the evening.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8)
• Master Bedroom: King bed, Private Master Bathroom, Private Patio
• Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom
• Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom.
• Loft Area: 1 Twin over Twin Bunk Bed

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Spacious 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms 2,500 SF PLUS Bunk Room! 
• Just a short driving distance from the private beach access for The Preserve
• Community is gated, offering the security that comes with it!
• Just steps from one of two community pools (West pool is heated seasonally!)
• Plenty of parking for you and your family
• gas grill for you to use! 

Blue Swell Vacation Rentals is a boutique property management company that specializes in top-of-the-line, luxury beach rentals from PCB, 30A, and Destin. Our loyal guests come back year after year because of the exclusive homes and condos we offer as well as the excellent service we provide. Our keyless entry, premier linens with 300 thread count sheets, plush towels, and high-end starter supplies are just the beginning of the convenient amenities we provide for every guest. Most importantly, Blue Swell’s phone service allows our guests to experience the best vacation ever with less stress. It is always a SWELL day at the beach!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Located in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and near the beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and scuba diving nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with ecotours and cycling.

Reviewer Comments:
From booking to check out, Blue Swell communicated frequently and responded in a helpful way to any questions we had. Check-in instructions were clear, as were those as we departed. Bathroom amenities were of high quality. Although we did not use the laundry facilities, it’s a plus to have them available. The house is lovely, and we felt at home right away. The kitchen is as well-equipped as one could wish, and the furnishings throughout the house are attractive, comfortable, and stylish. Nearby is the pool, and the beach is an easy walk away. After a restful 4-day Christmas visit, we reluctantly checked out but are already anticipating a future visit.
